summary: Visium Technologies filed an 8-K on September 21, 2026, disclosing execution of a non-binding term sheet with unnamed counterparties to assign specified contract-use, offtake, and deployment rights tied to a device design into a newly formed Indonesian PMA entity, PT Visium Compute Indonesia. A wholly owned Delaware subsidiary would hold 99 percent, with a local nominee holding 1 percent subject to drag-along, tag-along, and right-of-first-refusal provisions. The filing explicitly states this is not an acquisition of an existing operating company's equity and no historical liabilities transfer. Non-binding except exclusivity, confidentiality, expense allocation, and Florida law. Watch for definitive agreement timing, regulatory and Indonesian foreign-ownership mechanics, and any equity or financing overhang.
